hash_function.description: Hash function to use: 'MD4' or 'MD5' (default: MD4 for backward compatibility)

default_num_keys.description: Number of keys to generate in batch mode when -n is omitted (default: 1)

users.description:
List of pre-initialized S/KEY users for one-time password authentication (see skeykeys format in man donkey(1))
Each entry defines the user's login name, initial sequence number, seed, and optionally precomputed password hash (for setup automation). Not typical for runtime use, but used by configuration management systems to seed /etc/skeykeys or equivalent.
